document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, PDF p.6, §2.2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: RATE.TIME is Unix seconds from 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The authenticated SoLEXS tools package is consistent with this conversion but does not add a GTI endpoint contract.

document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, PDF p.5, §2.1.2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: RATE.COUNTS is counts per second in 2-22 keV.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This does not establish a physical irradiance or flux conversion.

document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, PDF p.5, §2.1.1; PDF p.6, §2.2
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The L1 GTI records intervals of valid collection and the manual states that all SoLEXS time-related data are Unix seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC; thus the GTI interval values share the documented time coordinate with RATE.TIME.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The authoritative manual does not name GTI column labels or define endpoint closure, empty/reversed/duplicated/malformed interval handling, or overlap handling. No filter may be applied.

document_filename_version_section_page: SoLEXS Data Analysis Guide Version 1.0, PDF pp.5-6, §§2.1.2-2.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: L1 light-curve RATE is associated with day-wise SDD1/SDD2 product directories and named detector products.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The release update does not define a general version-precedence rule.

phase4e_supported_interpretation: Daily release since July 2025 and historical data/software versions are documented; the 2025-02-14 update aligned timestamps to UTC and the 2025-04-05 pipeline update changed Date-obs Date-end MJDREFI/MJDREFF keywords.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: CREATOR DATE OBS_ID field definitions and complete product-version/configuration compatibility are not specified.

document_filename_version_section_page: solexs_tools-1.1 README CALDB section and bundled CALDB/arf/solexs_arf_SDD2_v1.arf plus CALDB/response/rmf/solexs_gaussian_SDD2_v1.rmf
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The authenticated official package supplies SDD2 ARF/RMF calibration artifacts for spectral analysis.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: Neither the package nor the manual supplies a direct audited light-curve counts/s-to-irradiance/flux conversion response-selection rule or uncertainty prescription.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF pp.51-52, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The documented Level-1 light-curve FITS example defines MJD as Modified Julian Date and labels the associated ISOT as UTC; TSTART/TSTOP are documented as MJD with UTC date/time forms.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The L1 manual does not designate an authoritative stored representation on disagreement, permissible tolerance/precision, or missing/malformed/inconsistent-field action. Level-2 code is not used as a Level-1 contract.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF pp.51-52, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The documented Level-1 light-curve FITS example defines ISOT as UTC ISO-T corresponding to MJD and gives its unit as UT.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The L1 manual does not state whether ISOT or MJD controls when stored values disagree, nor an allowed tolerance or rejection action. Level-2 code is not used as a Level-1 contract.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF pp.51-52, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: CTR is count rate in cts/sec for documented light-curve extensions.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No conversion to irradiance is implied.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF p.51, Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: STAT_ERR is uncertainty on count rate with cts/sec unit.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The manual excerpt does not define a more specific confidence or propagation policy.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF pp.5 13 51-52, §§2.1 and Appendix B.3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: Detector paths and LC extensions identify CdTe1/2 and CZT1/2; default broad bands are documented.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This does not establish current product-version precedence or calibration equivalence.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF p.13, Level-1 product description
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The four Level-1 GTIs span the entire dump and are relevant only to Level-2; the manual says they can be ignored for Level-1 analysis.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: This is a Level-1 use policy only; it supplies no endpoint or Level-2 inclusion convention.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Release Notes, PDF pp.4-5, Data Release 2 and Data Release 3
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The release notes require regenerated Jul-Sep 2024 release-2 products instead of release-1 products and warn of CZT event-list gaps in Dec 2023-Jun 2024.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: The official note does not identify V111/V211, map those identifiers to releases, state precedence for the observed February 2026 counterparts, or define cross-version calibration compatibility. Do not merge/select counterparts.

document_filename_version_section_page: HEL1OS Data Analysis User Manual Version 1.2 January 2025, PDF p.13 §4 and PDF pp.53-55 Appendix B.4
phase4e_supported_interpretation: The L1 manual identifies HK status and counter fields including fehkstat czt1/2bunpxst czt1/2hotpix czt1/2satctr1 and cdte1/2pilectr, and explains L1 GTIs are not a Level-1 quality filter.
phase4e_unresolved_limits: No L1 bit dictionary, saturation threshold, sentinel rule, row-rejection criterion, or exposure-invalidation policy is documented. The Level-2 saturation statement is not used to filter Level-1 data.
